notes:
v1.0.65 — Startup hang root-fix (Option B). Eliminates the "Still starting — poll #38" hang permanently by binding port 5000 before init completes, and teaching the Tauri polling loop to distinguish a live-but-initializing sidecar from a dead one.

### Fixes

- **"Still starting — poll #38" startup hang (root cause fix).** v1.0.64 widened the retry budget but didn't fix the root cause: `init_db()`, `migrate.run_if_needed()`, and webhook cleanup all ran synchronously before `socketio.run()` bound port 5000. On a cold post-PC-restart start the frozen Python interpreter can take 60–120 s for imports + DB init + 28 migrations; the Tauri polling loop saw only connection-refused and gave up before the port was ever bound. This release implements Option B: Flask binds port 5000 immediately and all heavy init runs in a background thread. While initializing, `/api/status` returns `503 {"status":"initializing"}`. The Tauri polling loop now treats HTTP 503 as "alive-but-initializing" (keep polling, no kill) and only treats connection errors as "dead" (increment counter, respawn after MAX_RETRIES).
